leader.name: LEADER (adapted, DPP-4i active-comparator proxy): liraglutide vs DPP-4i
leader.rct_endpoint: CV death, nonfatal MI or nonfatal stroke
leader.note: RCT placebo-controlled; DPP-4i comparator as in RCT-DUPLICATE; age >= 50 with CVD, CKD or HF (the >= 60 risk-factor stratum not applied)

sustain6.name: SUSTAIN-6 (adapted, DPP-4i active-comparator proxy): semaglutide vs DPP-4i
sustain6.rct_endpoint: CV death, nonfatal MI or nonfatal stroke
sustain6.note: RCT placebo-controlled (injectable semaglutide); oral (rybelsus) and obesity-dose (wegovy) tokens not counted

rewind.name: REWIND (adapted, DPP-4i active-comparator proxy): dulaglutide vs DPP-4i
rewind.rct_endpoint: nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke or CV death (incl. unknown causes)
rewind.note: RCT placebo-controlled; broad T2D age >= 50 (trial: CVD or risk factors; ~31% with CVD)

declare.name: DECLARE-TIMI 58 (adapted, DPP-4i active-comparator proxy): dapagliflozin vs DPP-4i
declare.note: RCT placebo-controlled; DPP-4i comparator as in RCT-DUPLICATE; benchmark = co-primary CV death or HF hospitalisation; CrCl >= 60 approximated by eGFR >= 60

canvas.name: CANVAS Program (adapted, DPP-4i active-comparator proxy): canagliflozin vs DPP-4i
canvas.rct_endpoint: CV death, nonfatal MI or nonfatal stroke
canvas.note: RCT placebo-controlled; DPP-4i comparator as in RCT-DUPLICATE

tecos.name: TECOS (adapted, sulfonylurea active-comparator proxy): sitagliptin vs sulfonylurea
tecos.rct_endpoint: CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke or UA hospitalisation
tecos.note: RCT placebo-controlled; sulfonylurea comparator as in RCT-DUPLICATE; other incretin users in prior year excluded

savor.name: SAVOR-TIMI 53 (adapted, sulfonylurea proxy): saxagliptin vs sulfonylurea
reasons_not_built: smaller arm with ECG = 101 < 300
savor.rct_endpoint: CV death, MI or ischaemic stroke
savor.note: RCT placebo-controlled; sulfonylurea comparator as in RCT-DUPLICATE

carmelina.name: CARMELINA (adapted, sulfonylurea proxy): linagliptin vs sulfonylurea in T2D with kidney disease
carmelina.rct_endpoint: CV death, nonfatal MI or nonfatal stroke
carmelina.note: RCT placebo-controlled; sulfonylurea comparator as in RCT-DUPLICATE; kidney risk = CKD/diabetic kidney disease/albuminuria code; dialysis excluded

tosca_it.name: TOSCA.IT (adapted): pioglitazone vs sulfonylurea added to metformin
reasons_not_built: smaller arm with ECG = 96 < 300
tosca_it.rct_endpoint: death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke, urgent coronary revascularisation
tosca_it.citation: Vaccaro et al. Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 2017;5:887-97 (PMID 28917544)
tosca_it.note: pragmatic open-label active-comparator RCT; HF excluded (trial excluded HF); urgent coronary revascularisation not captured

valiant.name: VALIANT (adapted): ARB vs ACEi after MI with LV dysfunction
valiant.note: class adaptation (trial: valsartan vs captopril, 0.5-10 d after MI with LVEF <= 35-40% and/or HF); EF > 40 excluded when known (as PARADISE-MI)

accomplish.name: ACCOMPLISH (adapted): amlodipine vs HCTZ added to RAS blockade in high-risk hypertension
reasons_not_built: near-duplicate cohort: 96% of (patient, index) records identical to v1.6 allhat
accomplish.rct_endpoint: CV death, MI, stroke, angina hospitalisation, resuscitated arrest, coronary revascularisation
accomplish.note: trial: benazepril + amlodipine vs benazepril + HCTZ; adaptation: ACEi/ARB order in prior 365 d (or at index) required; coronary revascularisation not captured

insight.name: INSIGHT (adapted): nifedipine vs thiazide in high-risk hypertension
insight.rct_endpoint: CV death, MI, HF or stroke
insight.note: trial: nifedipine GITS vs co-amilozide; thiazide class; risk factor = CVD, diabetes, LVH or hyperlipidaemia code

affirm.name: AFFIRM (adapted, sequential: rhythm-control drug added vs continued rate control)
affirm.note: as EAST-AFNET 4 design without the early-AF gate; trial age >= 65 or stroke risk factor (age >= 65 applied)

af_chf.name: AF-CHF (adapted, sequential: rhythm-control drug added vs continued rate control in HFrEF)
af_chf.note: trial: LVEF <= 35% with HF and AF; EF > 35 excluded when known

euclid.name: EUCLID (adapted): ticagrelor vs clopidogrel in PAD
reasons_not_built: smaller arm with ECG = 153 < 300
euclid.rct_endpoint: CV death, MI or ischaemic stroke
euclid.note: PAD by code; recent ACS excluded (trial excluded patients needing DAPT)

isar_react5.name: ISAR-REACT 5 (adapted): ticagrelor vs prasugrel in ACS
reasons_not_built: smaller arm with ECG = 245 < 300
isar_react5.rct_endpoint: death, MI or stroke at 1 y (ticagrelor vs prasugrel)

precision.name: PRECISION (adapted): celecoxib vs naproxen in arthritis with CV risk
precision.rct_endpoint: CV death (incl. haemorrhagic), nonfatal MI or nonfatal stroke (APTC)
precision.note: trial arms celecoxib / ibuprofen / naproxen; this emulation = celecoxib vs naproxen (prescribed orders; OTC use unseen); other NSAIDs in prior year excluded

cares.name: CARES (adapted): febuxostat vs allopurinol in gout with CVD
reasons_not_built: smaller arm with ECG = 161 < 300
cares.rct_endpoint: CV death, MI, stroke, UA with urgent revascularisation
cares.citation: White et al. NEJM 2018;378:1200-10 (PMID 29527974); one-sided 98.5% upper bound only
cares.note: febuxostat arm may have prior allopurinol use (as in CARES); allopurinol arm = new users; urgent revascularisation for UA approximated by UA hospitalisation

fast.name: FAST (adapted, sequential switch): febuxostat vs continued allopurinol
reasons_not_built: smaller arm with ECG = 94 < 300
fast.rct_endpoint: hospitalisation for MI/biomarker-positive ACS, stroke or CV death
fast.citation: Mackenzie et al. Lancet 2020;396:1745-57 (PMID 33181081); on-treatment primary
fast.note: trial: allopurinol users age >= 60 with >= 1 CV risk factor, randomised to switch or continue

oral_surv.name: ORAL Surveillance (adapted): tofacitinib vs TNF inhibitor in RA
reasons_not_built: smaller arm with ECG = 87 < 300
pooled events with ECG = 40 < 50

pronounce.name: PRONOUNCE (adapted): degarelix vs leuprolide in prostate cancer with ASCVD
reasons_not_built: smaller arm with ECG = 126 < 300
pronounce.rct_endpoint: death, MI or stroke at 12 months

amplify.name: AMPLIFY (adapted): apixaban vs warfarin for acute VTE
amplify.rct_endpoint: recurrent symptomatic VTE or VTE-related death
amplify.note: VTE within 30 d; AF excluded; recurrent VTE = new inpatient stay after the index stay with a VTE code

ideal.name: IDEAL (adapted): atorvastatin vs simvastatin after MI
reasons_not_built: smaller arm with ECG = 151 < 300
ideal.rct_endpoint: coronary death, nonfatal MI or resuscitated cardiac arrest
ideal.note: dose not identifiable (trial: atorvastatin 80 vs simvastatin 20-40); HF excluded (trial excluded HF)

lodestar.name: LODESTAR (adapted): rosuvastatin vs atorvastatin in CAD
lodestar.rct_endpoint: 3-y death, MI, stroke or any coronary revascularisation
lodestar.note: coronary revascularisation (part of the trial composite) not captured

prove_it.name: PROVE IT-TIMI 22 (adapted): atorvastatin vs pravastatin after ACS
prove_it.rct_endpoint: death, MI, UA rehospitalisation, revascularisation >= 30 d or stroke
